risks.risk: TV is not a Samsung or not the S90F model as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the TV's back or side showing the brand and model label, or a close-up of the front bezel or stand with branding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 55-inch OLED TV, not as a Samsung S90F, which would be significantly more valuable.

risks.risk: Screen damage or burn-in not visible in photos
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the screen displaying a static image for 30 seconds to check for burn-in, or a close-up of the screen under bright light to check for scratches or dead pixels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially having screen damage, which reduces value.

risks.risk: TV is not functional or has hidden defects
risks.proof: Video showing the TV turning on, changing inputs, and playing a video from a USB or streaming app for 30 seconds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.
